verdict.rationale: The founder says Zero automatically categorizes incoming email, which is a form of background AI processing [zero-comm-1]. The MCP server exposes label, archive, delete and send actions that an external agent could drive [zero-probe-1, zero-docs-2, zero-docs-11], but nothing shows users can define their own automations that Zero runs on its own. missing for 10: user-configurable automation rules or workflows, scheduled or triggered background runs, documentation of autonomous agent execution, independent hands-on corroboration.
